zh.title: 一个雨夜，我们听了三个鬼故事。心理恐怖小说《恐怖之夜物语第二夜》现已登陆Steam

en.title: On a rainy night, we listen to three ghost stories. Psychological horror novel “Terror Night Story Second Night” now available on Steam
en.summary: Individual indie game developer Himeko today began distributing the PC software ``Terror Night Story 2nd Night'' on Steam. This work is a psychological horror novel in which you read three ghost stories told in an old cafe. You can enjoy it even if you haven't played the previous game, ``Horror Night Story''.

items.title: 「歌マクロス」復活プロジェクト，支援総額1億3900万円を突破。50万文字超の「超時空シナリオブック」など追加リターンを発表

zh.title: 《超时空要塞》复兴计划总支援金额超过1.39亿日元。超50万字“超次元剧本书”等额外奖励公布

en.title: "Uta Macross" revival project exceeds 139 million yen in total support. Announcement of additional rewards such as “Super Dimension Scenario Book” with over 500,000 characters

zh.title: 灵魂般的动作“Valor Mortis”，你作为复活的拿破仑军队士兵与死者和奇怪的形式战斗，今天发布

en.title: Soul-like ACT “Valor Mortis”, where you fight the dead and strange forms as a revived Napoleon army soldier, released today

en.title: Automated Roguelike "Vena" will be released on November 9
en.summary: Vena, an automated roguelike game created by independent developer Leonhard and inspired by Factorio and Joker Cards, will be released on Steam on November 9. The demo will be participating in the Steam New Releases Festival, which will be held from October 19th to 26th. Players place plots on a hexagonal grid similar to "Carcassonne" and build production chains while meeting the growing resource demands at each stage. Choose your talents before each phase begins, and roll dice in the shop to buy new plots between phases. A smooth game often ends with a digital explosion, and the process of constant calculation and pursuit of perfect optimization is the greatest pleasure of the game. A game lasts between 15 and 50 minutes, and the game supports 29 languages, including Simplified Chinese. The developer stated that "Vena" is a sincere work developed by a single person.

zh.summary: 一般来说，专用于语音识别的人工智能模型用于转录，将语音转换为文本。然而，“Embedding Gemma Transcribe”已经出现，它采用了一种独特的方法，即使用 EmbeddingGemma 2 转录音频，这是一种用数字表达句子含义的嵌入式模型。 Embedding Gemma Transcribe 在配备 Apple Silicon 的 Mac 上运行，据说无需互联网连接即可处理音频，所以我实际上尝试使用它。阅读更多...

en.title: "Embedding Gemma Transcribe" which converted Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 into a speech recognition model, can transcribe 15 minutes of audio in just about 3 seconds on a Mac in an offline environment
en.summary: Generally, AI models dedicated to speech recognition are used for transcription, which converts speech into text. However, ``Embedding Gemma Transcribe'' has appeared, which adopts a unique approach of transcribing audio using EmbeddingGemma 2, an embedded model that expresses the meaning of sentences numerically. Embedding Gemma Transcribe runs on a Mac equipped with Apple Silicon and is said to be able to process audio without an Internet connection, so I actually tried using it. read more...

items.title: 古代ローマ人がポンペイの壁に残した「下品な落書き」のリスト、昔の人はどんな下品なことを考えていたのか？
items.summary: イタリア南部で1世紀頃に栄えた古代ローマの都市・ポンペイとヘルクラネウムでは、売春宿を合法のサービスとして運営していたことが明らかになっています。西暦79年に起きたヴェスヴィオ火山噴火に伴う火砕流によって地中に埋もれ、それにより当時の街並みが保存されたポンペイとヘルクラネウムの遺跡には、当時の人々が壁に書き残した落書きも数多く残されています。そんなポンペイとヘルクラネウムの壁から発見された、特に卑猥(ひわい)な内容を集めたサイトが「The Bawdy Graffiti of Pompeii and Herculaneum」です。続きを読む...

zh.title: 古罗马人在庞贝城墙上留下的“低俗涂鸦”清单，过去人们在想什么低俗的事情？
zh.summary: 很明显，在一世纪左右在意大利南部繁荣的古罗马城市庞贝和赫库兰尼姆将妓院作为一种合法服务进行经营。公元79年被维苏威火山喷发引起的火山碎屑流埋入地下的庞贝和赫库兰尼姆遗址，至今仍保留着当年的城市景观，墙上还有许多当时人们留下的涂鸦。 “庞贝和赫库兰尼姆的淫秽涂鸦”是一个收集从庞贝和赫库兰尼姆城墙上发现的特别淫秽内容的网站。阅读更多...

en.title: List of ``vulgar graffiti'' left by the ancient Romans on the walls of Pompeii, what kind of vulgar things were people thinking in the past?
en.summary: It has become clear that the ancient Roman cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which flourished in southern Italy around the 1st century, operated brothels as a legal service. The ruins of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which were buried underground by the pyroclastic flow caused by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD, have preserved the cityscapes of those days, and there are many graffiti left on the walls by the people of those days. "The Bawdy Graffiti of Pompeii and Herculaneum" is a site that collects particularly obscene contents discovered from the walls of Pompeii and Herculaneum. read more...

items.title: Googleの検索結果を収集するツールに通常とは異なるサイトが表示されているとの調査結果
items.summary: Google検索結果を機械的に収集して掲載ランキングなどのデータを提供する企業がいくつか存在します。こうした企業の多くが、同じタイミングでツールに不具合が生じたことを明らかにしました。2026年9月以降、ツールで収集した検索結果に、それまで上位に位置していたサイトが一時的に表示されなくなる現象が発生しているとのことです。続きを読む...

zh.summary: 有几家公司机械地收集谷歌搜索结果并提供出版物排名等数据。其中许多公司透露他们的工具同时失败了。自 2026 年 9 月以来，出现了一种现象，即之前在该工具收集的搜索结果中排名靠前的网站暂时不再显示。阅读更多...

en.title: Survey results show that unusual sites are displayed on Google's search result collection tool
en.summary: There are several companies that mechanically collect Google search results and provide data such as publication rankings. Many of these companies revealed that their tools failed at the same time. Since September 2026, a phenomenon has been occurring where sites that were previously ranked high in search results collected by the tool are temporarily no longer displayed. read more...
